items.title: George Masso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: When Bobby would come into town, they would have me play with them sometimes, lots of times, just Bobby and I and a rhythm section.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well you were convinced to come out of education into performing. I think I read this.

This is a great story I think. Bobby Hackett was a good friend and he was a friend of my dad’s. My father was a trumpet player, a professional trumpet player. And when I started playing, Bobby was from Providence originally, and I grew up in the Providence area. When Bobby would come into town, they would have me play with them sometimes, lots of times, just Bobby and I and a rhythm section. And at that time I was teaching school, I was raising four children, I was very much into the education bit. And Bobby…
